# thoth

> Containerized agent environment: OpenCode + goose/goosetown + kubectl,
> with a Prometheus metrics endpoint, a generic skill pack, and Docker
> Compose wiring. Maintained and supported by jarakube.eu.

thoth is a ready-to-run CLI agent container for infrastructure-heavy work
where Kubernetes and storage knowledge are needed in the same
environment. One shared LLM configuration feeds both OpenCode and goose;
API keys can come from `pass` via docker compose secrets.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/jarakube/thoth/blob/main/README.md): project overview, build/run (docker compose + Makefile), metrics endpoint, skills, goose/goosetown, MCP, CI, Keycloak notes
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jarakube/thoth/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for AI coding agents working on this repository (build/verify commands, conventions, DCO)
- [Skills](https://github.com/jarakube/thoth/blob/main/skills/README.md): the skill system - SKILL.md format, mapping skills into the container at runtime (bind mount, volume, ConfigMap, derived image), keeping private skills out; ships ceph (Ceph expert) and thoth (repo development incl. the in-container no-docker constraint)
- [MCP servers](https://github.com/jarakube/thoth/blob/main/docs/mcp.md): remote MCP servers for both agents; the jarakube.eu/mcp example; adding your own servers
- [Integrating other agents](https://github.com/jarakube/thoth/blob/main/docs/agents.md): Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI - install commands, skills locations, AGENTS.md support matrix, MCP config formats, derived-image recipes
- [LiteLLM configuration](https://github.com/jarakube/thoth/blob/main/LITELLM_CONFIGURATION.md): single-source LLM config for both agents (LLM_* env), pass/compose-secret key handling, OpenCode openai-compatible provider wiring
- [Goosetown integration](https://github.com/jarakube/thoth/blob/main/GOOSETOWN_INTEGRATION.md): what the image sets up for goose/goosetown (paths, wrappers, telepathy)
- [Suricata network monitoring](https://github.com/jarakube/thoth/blob/main/docs/suricata-docker-compose-integration.md): opt-in IDS sidecar - passive capture of agent traffic (EVE JSON: flow, dns, tls, http, alert, stats), make suricata-init/up/down/report targets, traffic overview script, egress blocking (block IP/domain via iptables in the shared namespace), caveats

## Examples

- [docker-compose.yml](https://github.com/jarakube/thoth/blob/main/docker-compose.yml): full stack wiring - workspace bind mount, opencode-data volume, LLM_* passthrough, llm_api_key secret, healthcheck
- [Makefile](https://github.com/jarakube/thoth/blob/main/Makefile): uid-matched build (make up), pass key loading, shell/run/logs targets
- [.env.example](https://github.com/jarakube/thoth/blob/main/.env.example): all configuration variables, commented
- [docker build (CI)](https://github.com/jarakube/thoth/blob/main/.github/workflows/build.yml): ghcr.io publish, owner-gated PR builds, Trivy digest scan
- [release pipeline](https://github.com/jarakube/thoth/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml): push a semver tag (v*) -> tagged image (vX.Y.Z / X.Y / X / latest), Trivy-scan, GitHub Release with digest and changelog
- [Helm chart](https://github.com/jarakube/thoth/blob/main/charts/thoth/README.md): deploy thoth to Kubernetes - single-replica StatefulSet, PVC-backed state (workspace/opencode/gnupg/beads), LLM key Secret, metrics probes + optional ServiceMonitor, pull-secret from values, Flux-compatible

## Optional

- [DCO policy](https://github.com/jarakube/thoth/blob/main/.github/workflows/dco.yml): every commit needs a Signed-off-by trailer
